lines.en: I decide to leave the girls to their own devices in gym class today.
Are they going to be fine on their own? Probably not. But I put Makoto in charge so, at the very least, everyone will be mostly contained.
Well, everybody except Futaba, that is.
Which isn't to say that she became some sort of delinquent overnight. I mean, how could she when she never even showed up to the class?
In fact, the main reason I decided to wander the halls is to find her.
I get that gym class can be taxing when you aren’t comfortable with your body, but it's not like running away is going to do anything to change that.
Especially when consistently running away is a thing that would probably get me in trouble if any of the other staff members found out.
It's not like I don't want to help her, of course.
I just don't know how...
Especially when I don't even know where she is.
Now...
Where would I go if I didn’t want to participate in class?
: Ah...S...Sensei...
: I knew it.
: What...are you doing in here?
: Aren’t you supposed to be in gym?
: Isn’t that what I should be asking you? Why are you in the nurse’s office?
: And...why isn't the nurse here?
: The nurse...doesn't work on Fridays.
: And I didn't really want to go to gym today, so...
: I decided to...take shelter here instead. I think I'd rather be alone right now anyway.
: Well, that sucks for you.
: Are you really going to make me go back right now? Yumi is-
: Who said anything about going back? I’m just going to hang out with you in here.
: Well...thank you. But we both know that you shouldn’t be doing that.
: Sometimes, it’s better to do the things that we shouldn’t do than the things we should.
: Is that...supposed to be inspirational?
: Beats me. But I’m going to hang out with you in here because I also don’t want to be bothered with teaching today.
: You...don’t ever really teach during gym anyway...
: Or...at all anymore, now that I think about it.
: Are you trying to start something, Futaba?
: S-Start something? Me? What would I even start?
: I promise I wasn’t trying to offend you.
: Too late, Futaba. I’m horribly offended. So offended that I might even have to give you what I imagine will be your first detention ever.
: Will you still give me detention if I pout like this? Just look how sad I am.
: I'm sorry. I’ve just...seen Ami use that technique before and it always seems to work on you...
: I can't imagine that I was anywhere near as cute as she is when she does it, though...
: It worked and you no longer have detention. Congratulations, Futaba.
: I obviously was never going to give you detention anyway, but now I’m definitely not going to. So, yeah. Good job.
: Umm...thank you? I think...
: You're welcome. I think.
: You know...you're really hard to follow sometimes, Sensei. I feel like I...never truly understand what sort of mood you're in.
: To be fair, neither do I most of the time. And I can pretty much guarantee that that won't be changing any time soon.
: Good. I don't really know how I'd react if you were just...suddenly a different person.
: I do. But I'm sure that me saying that is just another thing making me hard to follow.
: How...would you know my reaction to that, Sensei?
: You know, I'm just going to provide the typical cop out answer of it coming to me in a dream.
: A dream? Are you the type of person to have strange dreams like that often, Sensei?
: Not really. In fact, I barely dream at all- and most of the dreams I do have are a little too sexual to talk about in the school nurse's office.
: S...Sexual?!
: Well, I...suppose that it is normal for men to dream of things like that...
: It's normal for anyone to dream of things like that. We're free to have sex with anyone we want as long as it's in our dreams, Futaba.
: I don't...really know how you're expecting me to reply to that, but...my dreams are typically less...umm...that?
: Are you saying you don't dream about having sex with me? I'm offended.
: I thought you didn't want to talk about this in the nurse's office?!
For the first time in...probably forever, Futaba lets out a shockingly loud scream.
It's so loud, in fact, that if there was anyone near the nurse's office, I imagine they would have come rushing in right away.
Thankfully, this place is located a few halls down from the actual classrooms, so we should be safe, I think.
: Calm down. You want to be alone, don't you? Yelling will just draw attention.
: Besides, it wouldn't be weird if you had dreams like that about me. I'm sure you've popped up in some of mine before.
: Why would you dream about me when there are so many other prettier girls you could be dreaming about?
: You're very pretty yourself, Futaba. And you shouldn't be worried about those girls at all when you have two secret weapons tucked inside of your blazer.
: Weapons? But I'm not carrying-
: Oh.
: Yup.
: You haven’t even seen them, though...What if your dreams weren't an...accurate representation?
: Not seeing them is precisely why I have to rely on dreams, Futaba. I am simply working with what I have.
: So...if by some weird coincidence you did happen to see them...what then?
: What do you mean?
: I mean...If by some weird coincidence you saw them...and didn't have a reason to dream anymore...would your opinion of me change?
: Since there’d be no more mystery left...what would happen to me?
: Nothing at all.
: Well that’s a relief...For a second, I-
: I'd have to touch them first, too.
: Hah...of course.
: I am a simple man.
: Then, after you touch them-
: I’d have to fuck them.
: Is that even a thing that you can do?!
: Futaba, even if no one is around right now, you need to stop screaming.
: Well, I'm sorry, Sensei. But you just said something absolutely ridiculous.
: You...seriously haven't heard of titfucking before? Boobjobs?
: Were those really the best names they could come up with?
: How...how does that sort of thing even work? I don't get how that could possibly feel good.
: Don't say it, Sensei.
: I could show you?
: We’re in school! There's no way we can do something like that!
: Especially when I don't even know what to do!
: I mean, if you actually think about it, it should be pretty easy to figure out what to do.
: Are you...really serious about this?
: You're not...put off at all that we're in school?
: I was at first. But the fact that you have now screamed three times and no one has come barging in has instilled a new wave of confidence in me.
: That just makes me think we need better security...
: We probably do. Now, come on.
: Wait, Sensei...this is a joke right? You can't actually be serious right now.
: I'm extremely serious. Get over here.
: I really don't-
: Futaba, come.
: But...
: Ugh...
: Fine...
I move aside a curtain closing off one of the private infirmary beds and wait for Futaba to follow me inside before shutting it once again.
I figured there was roughly a 50%% chance of her actually following me in, so I'm glad I was able to beat the odds this time around now.
The only question now is whether I'll be able to get her to follow through...or if I'll wind up with nothing more than a little show between periods.
: Um...Would you mind explaining to me why I’m on the bed now?
: Sure. You’re going to take your shirt off.
: I’m what?
: You’re going to take your shirt off.
: Can we at least talk about this a little more?!
: What’s gotten into you today?
: Being alone with you in a semi-secluded area obviously turned me on. Now take your shirt off and I’ll be on my merry way.
: If there’s anything I’ve learned about you lately it’s that you will absolutely not be on your merry way...
: You're going to want to do other stuff too. Stuff like...in those dreams you have.
: Good point. We should probably do some of those too.
: That's just...crazy. We could get caught.
: Futaba.
: Sensei.
: You know what needs to be done.
: Hah...
: Fine...
: But just one look and you're done.
Futaba unbuttons her blazer and tosses it to the side, immediately bringing her hands to her breasts to lift them up.
: There...
: It’s off...
: Look at me.
: Why?...What do you want?...
: The bra needs to come off too.
: Isn’t this enough for today?...I think gym class should be over soon and-
: Futaba.
: You know, I really don't like this new pattern of you getting me to do naughty stuff by just saying my name and staring at me.
Futaba lifts her bra up with trembling fingers before holding back her braid to give me a better look.
Two enormous mounds appear before my eyes and awaken a primal instinct within me that could very well hurt this girl if I am not careful about suppressing it.
: Are you...happy now?...
: This is one of the happiest days of my life.
: You really mean that?...They're not too...too...
: I don't...really know how to say it...
: You’re beautiful, Futaba.
: Huh?
: I said you’re beautiful.
: But...I’m-
: Don’t even think about putting yourself down again. Just come over here.
: Why?...What are you going to do, Sensei?
: Have you try out that thing we were talking about earlier.
: The...b...boob job thing?...
: But I...still don't know how...
: Can I just use my hands again? I'm...more confident with those.
: I'm sure you'll be fine. And honestly, I can't imagine you'll have to do much work at all since looking at you has already gotten me half way to the end.
: Hah...you’re really lucky I like you so much...
Futaba comes closer and helps me remove my pants.
It’s a little worrying knowing that someone could come in here at any moment, but I honestly don’t care about the risk at this point.
I just want to get off as quickly as possible before anyone finds us...
I lie down on my back and guide her into the proper position.
: It...feels a little weird...Sensei...
: Don’t call me Sensei right now...
: What...would you like me to call you instead?...
